resources.string: NexSense is an exploration and logging tool, not a professional building-safety, health or laboratory instrument. Phone sensors are not calibrated.
All values in the demo project are made up and always shown with a “DEMO DATA” label. They never mix with your real projects.
Made-up sample data. Not a real measurement; for getting to know the app.
The file is not a NexSense project or is damaged.
The file is too large (50 MB max).
The data is inconsistent and was not saved (%1$s).
This file was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
Enter x, y and z together, or leave all three empty.
A measurement unit is missing or wrong; nothing was saved.
CSV needs at least one sample.
Create a project for a space (room, office, workshop), then add measurement points from the Live screen. You can first browse the clearly labelled demo project.
Collect measurement points with your phone\'s sensors and explore them layer by layer in a 3D scene relative to your own reference point. Measured, estimated and unknown are always shown apart.
Could not open the install confirmation.
The update is incompatible with this installation (the signature may differ).
Not enough free storage on the device.
No interpolation: only measured points are coloured; the space between means “not measured”.
%1$s: no data. No measurements were taken for this layer.
%1$d measured points. Hollow grey ring: not measured at this point.
No colour layer: points are shown by position only.
%1$d points have no position and are not shown.
Axes are in the phone\'s own frame (facing the screen: x right, y up, z out of the screen). Values are shown in the units the device reports, unconverted.
You can watch the values; open a project to record them.
Use “Add measurement point” on the Live screen to save the current sensor values.
Microphone permission was denied. Other sensors keep working.
The microphone could not be opened (another app may be using it).
Microphone permission is needed to measure sound level. Audio is not recorded; only the level is computed on the device.
%1$s project file(s) could not be read; they were left untouched.
Open or create a project on the Home screen.
No sensor samples at this point (note only).
Missing on most phones; external sensor support comes in Phase 3.
Magnets and metal inside the phone affect the value; hold the phone the same way when comparing.
dBFS relative to full scale; uncalibrated, not dB SPL. Audio is never recorded.
Only a real ambient temperature sensor is used. Battery or CPU temperature is not ambient temperature and is never substituted. Most phones lack this sensor; external sensor support comes in Phase 3.
RMS of gravity-free linear acceleration over the last ~100 samples (derived).
Saved with each measurement point. Magnetic disturbance can skew the azimuth.
Describe the physical point that is the origin (e.g. “bottom-left corner of the living room door, floor”). x goes right from it, y forward, z up.
NexSense asks only for the microphone, and only when you start sound level. Camera, location and Bluetooth are not used in this version.
Point “%1$s” and its samples will be deleted.
Metres from the project\'s reference point: x right, y forward, z up. GPS is unreliable indoors, so position is entered by hand.
If left empty, position is saved as “unknown” and the point is not shown in the 3D scene. No fake coordinates are made up.
Data stays on this device. The app never sends measurement data to any server; export only writes where you choose.
“%1$s” and its %2$d measurement points will be deleted permanently. You may want to export it as JSON first.

CSV writes one row per measurement component: time, project, point, sensor, value, unit, coordinates, source and quality. Missing values are empty cells. JSON stores the whole project in an importable form.
Opens a previously exported .nexsense.json file. If the same project exists it is not overwritten; a copy is added.
Open a project to export. Import is always available.
Sensors run only while the Live screen is open. High rate is better for vibration but uses more battery.
A session opens automatically with the first point.
Only points with a position (x, y, z) are placed in the scene. Points without a position: %1$d. You can add positions on the Points screen.
No points to show in the scene
3D scene with %1$d measurement points. Drag to rotate, pinch to zoom, tap to select.
